standards.text: The learners demonstrate an understanding of principles in the overview of swine production, Occupational Safety and Health Standards, and tools, materials, and equipment used in swine production according to industry standards.
The learners perform waste management using tools, materials, and equipment.
The learners demonstrate an understanding in swine housing, breed selection, and breeding management for efficient and sustainable production of industry standards.
The learners perform breeding management of sows and boars according to industry standard.
The learners demonstrate an understanding of health and care management practices across the stages of swine production.
The learners perform health and care management on the different stages of swine production according to industry standards.
The learners demonstrate an understanding of Health Management, Record Keeping, Harvesting and post-harvest Management and Marketing in swine production in compliance with industry requirements.
The learners perform health management, harvesting and post harvesting, record keeping and marketing in swine production according to industry standard.
